prompt: Your team wants agents to operate as autonomously as possible without compromising security. What is the BEST approach to balancing speed and safety?
explanation: Correct answer: B) Assign autonomy levels based on risk classification, minimizing approvals that do not materially reduce risk

options.text: Remove all guardrails to maximize delivery speed
Assign autonomy levels based on risk classification, minimizing approvals that do not materially reduce risk
Require human approval for every agent action regardless of risk
Allow agents to self-elevate their autonomy level based on task complexity
